name: 编辑任务
desc: 行内铅笔打开详情并进入编辑模式、预填当前标题与描述、空白标题禁用保存、保存同步列表与详情、取消丢弃修改、不改完成状态与时间戳、刷新后落盘

steps.eval: if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.wipe = async () => { const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const K = '__todo_test_backup_v1'; if (localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_dirty') === '1') { const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K) || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } } const snap = { todos: await s.getItem('todos'), groups: await s.getItem('groups'), ui: await s.getItem('ui') }; localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(snap)); localStorage.setItem('__todo_test_dirty', '1'); await s.removeItem('todos'); await s.removeItem('groups'); await s.removeItem('ui'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'wiped, backup todos=' + (snap.todos ? snap.todos.length : 0); }; return await T.wipe();

if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.q = (s) => { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const r = p && p.shadowRoot; return r ? Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s)) : []; }; T.ready = async (sel, ms) => { const n = Math.ceil((ms || 3000) / 100); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (T.q(sel).length) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('页面就绪超时，找不到 ' + sel); }; T.tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); T.click = (el) => { if (!el) throw new Error('元素不存在'); const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); return true; }; T.byText = (sel, t) => T.q(sel).find((e) => T.tx(e) === t) || null; T.btn = (t) => T.click(T.byText('st-button', t)); T.dlg = () => T.q('st-dialog').find((d) => d.hasAttribute('open')) || null; T.dlgBtn = (t) => { const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('当前没有打开的弹窗'); return T.click(Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === t)); }; T.dlgHead = () => T.tx(T.dlg().querySelector('[slot=headline]')); T.wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms || 300)); T.items = () => T.q('.item'); T.item = (t) => T.items().find((i) => T.tx(i.querySelector('.text')) === t) || null; T.need = (t) => { const i = T.item(t); if (!i) throw new Error('找不到任务：' + t); return i; }; T.setVal = (el, v) => { if (!el) throw new Error('输入元素不存在'); el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true; }; T.NL = String.fromCharCode(10); T.addTask = async (title, desc) => { T.btn('添加任务'); await T.wait(350); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('添加弹窗未打开'); T.setVal(d.querySelector('.dialog-field'), desc ? title + T.NL + desc : title); await T.wait(250); T.dlgBtn('添加'); await T.wait(400); return true; }; T.toggle = (t) => T.click(T.need(t).querySelector('st-checkbox').shadowRoot.querySelector('input')); T.edit = (t) => T.click(T.need(t).querySelector('.edit-btn')); T.openDetail = (t) => { T.need(t).querySelector('.body').click(); return true; }; return 'helpers ready';

await T.ready('.add-group-btn'); await T.addTask('写周报', '本周总结'); T.openDetail('写周报'); await T.wait(450); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('点正文应打开详情弹窗'); if (T.dlgHead() !== '写周报') throw new Error('详情标题应为任务标题，实际 ' + T.dlgHead()); const txt = d.textContent; if (txt.indexOf('本周总结') === -1) throw new Error('详情应显示描述全文'); if (txt.indexOf('状态') === -1 || txt.indexOf('未完成') === -1) throw new Error('详情应显示状态'); if (txt.indexOf('分组') === -1) throw new Error('详情应显示分组'); T.dlgBtn('关闭'); await T.wait(350); if (T.dlg()) throw new Error('点「关闭」应关闭详情'); return 'ok';

T.edit('写周报'); await T.wait(450); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('点铅笔应打开详情弹窗并进入编辑'); if (T.dlgHead() !== '编辑任务') throw new Error('编辑模式标题应为「编辑任务」，实际 ' + T.dlgHead()); if (d.querySelector('.edit-title').value !== '写周报') throw new Error('标题应预填：' + d.querySelector('.edit-title').value); if (d.querySelector('.edit-desc').value !== '本周总结') throw new Error('描述应预填：' + d.querySelector('.edit-desc').value); const save = Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === '保存'); if (save.hasAttribute('disabled')) throw new Error('标题非空时「保存」应可用'); return 'ok';

T.setVal(T.dlg().querySelector('.edit-title'), '   '); await T.wait(350); const save = Array.from(T.dlg().querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === '保存'); if (!save.hasAttribute('disabled')) throw new Error('标题为空白时「保存」应禁用'); T.setVal(T.dlg().querySelector('.edit-title'), '周报（新）'); T.setVal(T.dlg().querySelector('.edit-desc'), '第一行' + T.NL + '第二行'); await T.wait(350); T.dlgBtn('保存'); await T.wait(450); const i = T.need('周报（新）'); const desc = T.tx(i.querySelector('.desc')); if (desc !== '第一行' + T.NL + '第二行') throw new Error('列表描述未同步：' + desc); if (T.dlgHead() !== '周报（新）') throw new Error('保存后详情应回到只读并显示新标题：' + T.dlgHead()); if (T.dlg().textContent.indexOf('第一行') === -1) throw new Error('保存后详情应显示新描述'); T.dlgBtn('关闭'); await T.wait(350); return 'ok';

T.edit('周报（新）'); await T.wait(450); T.setVal(T.dlg().querySelector('.edit-title'), '不该保存'); await T.wait(300); T.dlgBtn('取消'); await T.wait(450); if (!T.item('周报（新）')) throw new Error('取消编辑后原值应保留'); if (T.item('不该保存')) throw new Error('取消编辑不应写入新值'); return 'ok';

T.toggle('周报（新）'); await T.wait(400); T.edit('周报（新）'); await T.wait(450); T.setVal(T.dlg().querySelector('.edit-title'), '周报（最终）'); await T.wait(300); T.dlgBtn('保存'); await T.wait(450); const i = T.need('周报（最终）'); if (i.className.indexOf('done') === -1) throw new Error('编辑不应影响完成状态'); const meta = T.tx(i.querySelector('.meta')); if (meta.indexOf('默认 · 创建于') !== 0) throw new Error('编辑不应改分组与创建时间：' + meta); if (meta.indexOf('完成于') === -1) throw new Error('编辑不应清掉状态变更时间：' + meta); return 'ok';

let root = null; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); root = p && p.shadowRoot; if (root && root.querySelector('.shell')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!root || !root.querySelector('.shell')) throw new Error('刷新后页面未就绪'); const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.item')); if (items.length !== 1) throw new Error('刷新后应有 1 条任务，实际 ' + items.length); const i = items[0]; if (i.querySelector('.text').textContent.trim() !== '周报（最终）') throw new Error('刷新后标题未落盘：' + i.querySelector('.text').textContent.trim()); if (i.querySelector('.desc').textContent.trim() !== '第一行' + String.fromCharCode(10) + '第二行') throw new Error('刷新后描述未落盘'); if (i.className.indexOf('done') === -1) throw new Error('刷新后完成状态应保留'); return 'ok';

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_backup_v1') || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } localStorage.removeItem('__todo_test_dirty'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'restored';
